name: Firebase Config Reaches the Build (keys set; not a live connection)
note: Without the config the transport falls back to same-device mode. Every 1v1 gate still passes, because two tabs on one machine really do meet — and no two phones ever would.

mutations.name: a config key firebaseApp.js reads is missing from .env.example
mutations.why: A fresh clone then builds an app whose 1v1 silently never leaves the device, and nothing says so.

mutations.name: vite.config moves where the build reads env files
mutations.why: External audit V11. The gate parsed ROOT/.env itself, so it kept passing when the build was told to read somewhere else and got nothing. It now asks vite.config where the build looks, so the answer is the build's answer.
